clue.text: Utter refutation of housing list request?

definitions.meaning: an outright, absolute rejection of a claim
read literally: the refusal someone on a council housing waiting list gets when their application for somewhere to live is turned down

explanation.definitionFit: A complete, unqualified rebuttal is a flat no; and an applicant refused an apartment has had that dwelling denied.

clue.text: Expression used to attract attention

definitions.meaning: the ... on a face, a facial appearance
the interjection said to make someone pay heed, as in '..., I've had enough'

explanation.definitionFit: A face's appearance is its look, and the imperative 'look!' is a call for someone's attention.

clue.text: Thanks to Shakespeare it was worn by knights

parts.note: TA is informal British for thank you
the Bard is Shakespeare's familiar title

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's plays are why we know what knights wore.
explanation.definitionFit: A short sleeveless tunic bearing a coat of arms was worn over armour by medieval knights.

clue.text: It laces combinations' extensively

indicators.note: combinations suggests the letters of the preceding words are put together in a different order

explanation.surface: Something laces up a corset or undergarment over a wide area.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranging the seven letters of IT LACES gives the answer; 'combinations' as the old one-piece undergarment adds to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Something stretchy can be pulled out widely, extending far beyond its resting size.

clue.text: Bloomer that takes in the pupil

definitions.meaning: a flower, something that blooms; here a garden plant with tall flowers
the coloured ring of the eye that surrounds the pupil

explanation.definitionFit: The flag is a flowering plant, and the coloured membrane of the eye encircles its central black opening.

clue.text: Maybe a match but not matching in depth of colour

definitions.meaning: a match is one example of something used to ignite a flame

definitions.text: not matching in depth of colour
definitions.meaning: paler, of a less deep shade than another

explanation.definitionFit: A device for igniting cigarettes is one example of fire-starter like a match, and a paler shade is less dark.

clue.text: A double-six on a circular wedge identifies animal carver

indicators.note: double means the letters for the word six are written down twice

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
a sector is a wedge-shaped part of a circle

explanation.surface: Two sixes landing on a segment of a dartboard or roulette wheel point to a butcher.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dissects living creatures for experiments is a carver of animals.

clue.text: Counsel amplifying for a deaf witness

definitions.text: Counsel amplifying for a deaf witness

parts.words: Counsel amplifying for a deaf witness
parts.note: reads like a barrister raising their voice in court, but describes a small device that boosts sound for someone hard of hearing, giving help (aid) to their hearing

explanation.surface: A lawyer raises their voice so a witness who cannot hear well can follow.
explanation.definitionFit: An electronic device worn in the ear amplifies sound for people who are partly deaf.

clue.text: Sound vision needed by city developer

indicators.note: sound signals that the word for vision is to be taken as it is pronounced, not spelt

parts.note: sight is the faculty of vision

clue.text: Understanding the purpose of a compass

definitions.meaning: a compass exists to give a direction of travel, i.e. it is for a bearing

explanation.definitionFit: A patient, tolerant person is sympathetic; and a compass is used to find a direction, a bearing.

clue.text: His business is stocking for sale

definitions.text: His business is stocking for sale

parts.words: His business is stocking for sale
parts.note: seems to describe any shopkeeper keeping goods in stock, but the trader in question sells stockings, socks and tights

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper keeps his shelves full of goods to sell.
explanation.definitionFit: A dealer in socks, stockings and other legwear sells stockings.

clue.text: Crosby upset about ageing but valuable writer

indicators.note: about means the turned name goes around the word for ageing
upset, in a down light, turns the singer's name backwards

parts.note: Bing Crosby, the American crooner
old means ageing

explanation.surface: An elderly Bing Crosby, upset about growing old, is still a valuable singer.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down-style reading 'upset' would mean overturned, but here in an across light it simply signals the crooner's first name read backwards, with 'about' wrapping it round the ageing word.
explanation.definitionFit: A fountain pen tipped with the precious metal is a valuable writing implement.

clue.text: Smoother mirror on the Mirror?

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the first piece above the second

parts.note: a mirror is a looking glass
the Daily Mirror is a British tabloid newspaper

explanation.surface: A mirror propped on a copy of the Mirror newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Abrasive sheet coated with powdered grit is used to smooth wood.

clue.text: Reprimanding, but not ground, ing a pilot

definitions.meaning: allowing an aviator to take to the air rather than keeping them on the ground

explanation.definitionFit: Lashing out verbally is a scolding; and permitting an airman to go up is the opposite of grounding him.

clue.text: Extra payment on entering bus

indicators.note: entering means the word on goes inside the word bus

explanation.surface: A passenger gets a reward just for boarding the bus.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum paid on top of normal wages is an additional reward.

clue.text: "—— two worlds life hovers like a star" Byron's Don Juan

parts.words: "—— two worlds life hovers like a star" Byron's Don Juan
parts.note: a fill-in-the-blank quotation: the missing first word of Byron's line from Don Juan, a preposition meaning amid

explanation.surface: A line from Byron's Don Juan with its first word missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Byron's Don Juan opens the line with the preposition meaning in the middle of two things.

clue.text: Shrink from being in debt when in credit

to owe is to be in debt

clue.text: Bet…

explanation.definitionFit: Sicily's active volcano is the eruptive mountain on the island.

clue.text: Soothsayer whose pronouncement is a bit of a bore

parts.note: an auger is a drilling bit, a tool for boring holes

explanation.definitionFit: A Roman religious official who foretold events from omens was a prophet or seer.

clue.text: A tax, as the saying goes, levied on the enemy

parts.note: the phrase is said aloud to give the letters entered

explanation.surface: A tax, so the expression runs, is imposed on the enemy.

clue.text: End-of-term celebration calls for music that is…

definitions.meaning: a rag is a British student carnival raising money
a syncopated style of American piano music popular around 1900

clue.text: Jinn gins

definitions.meaning: genies, supernatural beings of Arabian folklore
gins are examples of distilled liquors

explanation.definitionFit: Genies are supernatural beings or ghosts, and gin is one kind of strong distilled drink.

clue.text: Date-rum distilled and fully aged

indicators.note: distilled hints at a reworking process, so the letters of the hyphenated phrase are rearranged

explanation.surface: A spirit made from dates, distilled and left to grow old in the cask.
explanation.definitionFit: Ripened over time, as whisky or cheese is when fully developed with age.

clue.text: … popularly optimistic

parts.note: carries on from the previous clue's music, describing it as cheerful in everyday language

explanation.definitionFit: Cheerful and positive is the colloquial sense, and bright music has a lively beat.

clue.text: Fine wool from Bangor area

indicators.note: from shows the letters are taken out of the place-name phrase that follows

explanation.surface: A fine fleece produced in the region around Bangor, in Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: Bangor is a town in north Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft yarn from the long silky hair of a goat or rabbit is a fine wool.

clue.text: Just picture overturning vessels on the stove

parts.note: pans are cooking vessels used on a stove

clue.text: Soft butter needs pushing

parts.note: P is piano, the musical abbreviation for soft
a ram is a male sheep, one that butts

explanation.surface: Softened butter wants pushing around the bowl.

clue.text: Length of time in the middle

indicators.note: in places the word time inside the word for the middle

clue.text: When waiters somehow presume tip
